comment: A Delay Samples parameter delays the clock by up to ten samples before the registers see it (Sheliak.cpp:268-277). It has no widget on the panel and no menu item, so nothing in the running module can reach it and it stays at zero. The three triplet lamps are driven from the main register rather than the triplet register (Sheliak.cpp:355-361), so they do not match the triplet outputs beside them.
